about.text1: I'm a Full Stack Developer with 3+ years of experience and a genuine passion for turning ideas into working software. My journey started with a curiosity for how the web works — and it quickly grew into a deep dive across the entire stack: from pixel-perfect front-ends with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, to back-end development with PHP and Python, to low-level programming in C, C++, C#, and Java. Whether it's a sleek web app or an automation tool, I love building things that are both functional and well-crafted.
about.text2: I believe in clean code, intuitive design, and continuous learning. Whether it's crafting pixel-perfect interfaces or building efficient backend scripts, I approach every project with attention to detail and a drive to deliver excellent results.
